body:
Implemented locally on `feature/block-assist-visibility`; ready for user visual review.

Implemented the explicitly approved missing Multiple Block native-prompt adapter. Existing native reroll/face choices retain target identity, source and index; uphill attacker face selection stays unavailable. Browser choices expose target labels and keyboard/pointer assist inspection without issuing a command. Added mixed chooser, freezing, clearing and adapter regressions.

Validation completed:
- 59 affected native tests passed across feature, metadata, movement, Multiple Block, follow-up, recovery and refreshed projection selectors. Final server JAR/ZIP and focused state-test reactor verify succeeded.
- Browser unit suite: 350/350 passed. All nine affected browser UI suites passed, including native block/blitz/uphill/Multiple Block visibility, replay/reconnect and 56 reroll-choice cases.
- Type checking, both browser production builds, 430-asset synchronization check and diff whitespace check passed.
- The initial full Maven verify ran 939 cases with six assertion failures; all six were fixed and their selectors passed in focused reruns. Nine existing environment-gated opt-in checks stayed skipped. The whole clean suite was not repeated after the focused fixes.

Local evidence: `docs/specs/block-assist-visibility-outcome.md`, `.notes/block-assist-visibility/` logs/review record and `.notes/art-preview/block-assists/production-regression/` screenshots. No unresolved review findings. Physical mobile devices/other operating systems and the opt-in database/runtime checks remain unverified.

Changes are unstaged and uncommitted. Nothing pushed, published, merged or deployed; issue remains open pending review.
